description: Handle context hydration for PR line comments (pull_request_review_comment). Fetch the review comment, check its position field — if null, the comment is outdated (code it was attached to has changed). For outdated comments, respond with a clarify status update explaining the context is stale rather than attempting to act. For non-outdated comments, fetch the diff hunk (patch field), file path, and current file content via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}?ref={head-sha}.
title: GitHub context hydration — PR line comments and outdated detection
